shortDescription.default: Site Toolkit - fourteen everyday SharePoint web parts that need no API permissions

longDescription.default: Fourteen web parts and an alert banner for content health, productivity, people and engagement. Everything runs as the signed-in user through SharePoint REST and Search only: no Microsoft Graph permissions, no Azure AD app registration and no external services. All requests go through one page-wide queue that sends one request at a time and backs off when SharePoint asks it to.
